# Data Handling

### Prior checks

default_priors_list[[topic]]

### Models
```{r models}
columns_by_topic <- survey_data %>% 
  select(starts_with(str_glue("q8_{topic}"))) %>% 
  names()

model_output <- pblapply(columns_by_topic, function(is_x_taught) {
  
  print(is_x_taught)
  print(response_by_discipline_tables[[is_x_taught]])
  
  print("model summary")
  print(model_summary_list[[is_x_taught]])
  
  print("probability estimates")
  print(probability_estimates_list[[is_x_taught]])
  
  print("model plot")
  print(model_plot_list[[is_x_taught]])
  
  print("post-predictive check")
  print(pp_check_list[[is_x_taught]])
  
  print("conditional effects")
  print(conditional_effects_list[[is_x_taught]])
  
  print("sensitivity analysis table")
  print(sensitivity_analysis_list[[is_x_taught]])
  
  print("sensitivity analysis plot")
  print(sensitivity_plot_list[[is_x_taught]])
  
})
```
